limitations: Snapshot generation time is not the publication or last update time of each underlying list.
All required sources must contain records; this alone does not prove that each source is complete or up to date.
Names and aliases belong to source records; the same person or organization can occur on several lists.
CSL excludes the SDN list already imported through OFAC; overlap across other lists is retained with provenance.
World Bank debarment is separate from sanctions. Current MEPs provide only limited PEP coverage.
This artifact is an import, not a screening decision or a finding that an entity is clear.
